HOW TO PLAY

Mobile: Move

Touch and drag anywhere to guide your dragon.

Mobile: Boost

Tap and hold the BOOST button for speed burst.

PC

Move=Mouse, Boost=Click/Space, Pause=ESC

Head vs Head

Longer dragon wins. Shorter dies. Equal size = both shrink.

Head vs Tail

Instant kill of the dragon whose tail was hit.

Head vs Body

Smaller dragon dies. Larger unaffected. Equal = both shrink.

Tail vs Tail

Nothing happens.

Collect ∞

Eat infinity symbols to grow. Start small, grow to max size.

3 Lives

Each dragon has 3 lives. Die 3 times and you're eliminated.
